verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only decision outputs: approve/decline via /decide and /submit, allow/notify/challenge for logins, approve/review/decline for claims, and CVV/3DS or TRA/SCA recommendations. Nothing shows per-transaction risk factors, reason codes, or explanations returned alongside a score. Explainability is a fair axis for a fraud-scoring product, so absence of evidence is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As a risk analyst, every score comes with its top risk factors — why this transaction looks risky — not just an opaque number
